Maya: Quick sync — finalizing newsletter segmentation for the May webinar on benchmarks. Need sign-off on audience splits and subject line tests.
Jasper: Proposed splits: 60% product-engaged, 25% trialers, 15% cold signups. Thoughts?
Ava: 60/25/15 seems right. For trialers, include CTA to book a demo + secondary CTA to view benchmark blog.
Sam: For creative, we should avoid 'webinar' in subject for cold segment. Suggest: 'How teams cut LLM inference costs — short read' for cold.
Riley: For timing: send invite 7 days prior, reminder 2 days prior, last-chance 3 hours prior. For APAC, shift base send by +12h.
Maya: A/B subject lines for product-engaged: A) 'Benchmark: 3 ways to halve gen time' B) 'Redwood's benchmark: performance you can trust' — vote?
Jasper: I'm for A for click curiosity. B for trust; maybe B for enterprise segment.
Morgan: Inbound routing: register -> tag as webinar_reg, if from trial attach priority routing to SDRs; else nurture flow.
Ava: Also add suppression: exclude customers who opened similar email in last 14 days and those unsubscribed.
Maya: Content snippet for email body (draft):

`````
Hey {{first_name}},

Join us on May 12 for a 30-min dive into real-world LLM inference benchmarks. We'll cover latency, cost, and tradeoffs with quantized models.

Reserve your seat → {{reg_link}}

See you there,
—The Redwood Team
`````

Sam: Visual: hero image with 3-panel benchmark chart, CTA button primary orange #ff7a2d
Riley: Analytics hooks: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=webinar_may&utm_medium=email; add `webinar_reg` event in GA and Segment.
Maya: Can we get copyfinal by EOD tomorrow? Jasper + Sam to update creative. I'll wire up suppressions with ops.
Jasper: On it. Sending updated subject variants by noon.
Morgan: I'll map registration webhook to Salesforce: LeadSource=Newsletter, Event=Webinar_May, Tag=webinar_reg
Ava: :thumbsup:
